svg.title: Switzerland: Relief and Water
svg.desc: Situation map covering 5.7°E to 10.7°E, 45.6°N to 48.0°N. A reference plate: terrain, lakes and rivers with no thematic layer over them. Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer. Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; SRTM-derived shaded relief.
